title: Additivity of the standard derived functors
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] admitting a derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], equipped with its standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. For every $q,n\in\mathbf Z$, the canonical truncation $\tau_{\le q}:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$, cohomology $H^q:D(\mathcal A)\to\mathcal A$, single-term functor $S_n:\mathcal A\to D(\mathcal A)$ placing its argument in degree $n$, and shift $[n]:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ are additive: each sends a sum of parallel morphisms to the sum of their images. No boundedness or enough-injectives assumption is required.
